hypothesis: one-sided speculative price discovery in young perpetuals decays as contracts season and natural hedge/arbitrage participation matures

features.name: past_visible_first_transaction_open
features.endpoint_or_archive: Binance public USD-M monthly transaction klines archive; frozen bars.parquet
features.available_timestamp: decision t once the transaction-bar row exists in past context; the price at t remains hidden
features.lag: minimum open_time observed for the symbol at or before t; no future row may revise the runtime value
features.transformation: f_i(t)=min_{s<=t}(open_time_i,s); use timestamps only and read no open, close, volume, or other market value
features.missing_data_behavior: a symbol with no past-visible first open is excluded

features.name: left_censor_flag
features.endpoint_or_archive: derived from frozen bars.parquet timestamp lineage
features.transformation: left_censored_i = 1 exactly when f_i(t) == 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z; equality only
features.missing_data_behavior: no imputation; first opens after snapshot start are never labeled censored

features.name: contract_lifecycle_age
features.lag: uses f_i(t) already visible at t
features.transformation: age_i(t)=(t-f_i(t))/1 day; young iff not left-censored and 30<=age<=270; mature iff left-censored or age>=540
features.missing_data_behavior: exclude missing or negative age; all threshold boundaries are inclusive

features.name: pit_fillable_eligibility
features.event_timestamp: Monday 00:00 UTC reconstitution and decision-time transaction open
features.available_timestamp: latest reconstitution at or before decision t; existence of open at t
features.transformation: current eligible_symbols intersect symbols having an executable open at t; membership liquidity_rank is not alpha and decision-open price is hidden
features.missing_data_behavior: no current membership or no decision-time open means ineligible

state.runtime_state: past-derived minimum transaction open_time per symbol
state.update_rule: append-only minimum over context available by each call

schedule.rule: explicit rebalance at 00:00 UTC when nonnegative integer days since anchor is divisible by 14
schedule.all_other_8h_boundaries: return None and hold quantities subject to central exits and risk controls

portfolio_construction.young_short: sort (age ASC, symbol ASC), select five youngest, weight -0.08 each
portfolio_construction.mature_long: sort (age DESC, symbol ASC), select five oldest, weight +0.08 each

execution_only_inputs.use: hidden next-open fills, 0.10% participation caps, unfilled-gap carry, and forced exits; never alpha
cashflow funding_pnl=-signed_position_notional*funding_rate; boundary funding precedes trading; never alpha
common exposure, risk accounting, disappearing-contract exits, and adverse residual delist settlement; never alpha

common_execution.weekly_removal_or_disappearance: participation-capped normal-cost exit; remaining delist notional receives adverse full-notional settlement

validation.primary_gate: both sleeves material, base and 2x Sharpe positive, and no more than 3 of 5 calendar buckets negative
validation.basin: young maximum {180,270,360} days x cadence {7,14,28} days with mature minimum 540; diagnostic only, never a handoff switch
validation.nested_protocol: fixed primary across six half-year outer folds; past-only state, 14-day label purge and 28-day embargo
validation.nested_gate: positive median outer base Sharpe, at least 4/6 positive outer base folds, and positive median outer 2x Sharpe

validation.handoff: organizer-advance exact fixed candidate with qr_accepted=false; no neighboring-cell selection and no public OOS
